prerequisites: Basic knowledge of engineering techniques acquired in previous courses

learning_outcomes.text: Know the processes for project management and the competencies of the Project Manager.
Develop a project plan. Identify and assess project risks, develop the risk management plan, and monitor it.
Assess the application of predictive management techniques or agile management techniques and apply them to project management.
Manage R&D projects and understand their differentiating characteristics.
Use collaborative project management tools and risk assessment tools.
Express oneself correctly in the terminology of the subject orally and in writing.

teaching_methods: Collaborative activities (conferences, seminars, joint projects) with Ingenium alliance universities

assessment_methods.method: Continuous assessment (questions and tests on theoretical content)
Theoretical exam (theoretical and/or applied questions, problems, case studies)
Group or individual assignments (process, individual contribution, deliverables, presentation, and defense)

assessment_rules: To pass the subject, each part must be approved with a minimum score of 5 out of 10. The final grade will be the weighted sum of the partial grades. For students with differentiated assessment, the evaluation consists of a theoretical exam worth 60% and an individual practical assignment worth 40%.
